en.title: Daily Accessibility Digest: Home Assistive Tech, Public Transit Improvements, and Polling Place Accessibility
en.summary: Today three key accessibility stories emerge: Consumer Reports highlights innovative home gadgets designed to enhance independence for people with disabilities and seniors, featuring smart home devices and adaptive tools. In Sacramento, SacRT announces plans to expand wheelchair accessible service to improve public transit options. Meanwhile, accessibility concerns are rising at Macon Mall where long parking distances are challenging elderly voters and those with mobility issues, raising questions about physical accessibility at polling locations.

highlights.title: Consumer Reports: Helpful accessible home gadgets
SacRT to Expand Wheelchair Accessible Service
Accessibility concerns rise as Macon Mall parking distance challenges elderly voters

zh-TW.title: 每日無障礙資訊：家居輔助科技、公共交通改善及投票站無障礙問題
zh-TW.summary: 今日有三則重要的無障礙資訊：《消費者報告》介紹了專為增強殘疾人和老年人獨立性的創新家居設備，涵蓋智能家居設備和輔助工具。薩克拉門托區域交通局宣布擴大輪椅無障礙服務的計劃，旨在改善公共交通選項。同時，梅肯購物中心的無障礙問題日益受到關注，長距離的停車位對老年選民和行動不便者構成挑戰，引發了對投票地點實體無障礙設施的質疑。

highlights.title: 消費者報告：實用的無障礙家居設備
SacRT 擴大輪椅無障礙服務
停車距離挑戰老年選民 梅肯購物中心無障礙問題引發關注
